en.title: As something inhuman approaches his home, he must also respond to frequent messages from his lover. Survival horror with only stress “Sleepless Night with the Devil and Girlfriend”, playtest underway
en.summary: TailtoneGames has started a playtest of ``The Devil, the Girlfriend, and the Sleepless Night'' by Ixavon on Steam. This work is a survival horror story in which the player survives the night as a monster approaches his home while maintaining his relationship with his lover and searching for his missing friend.

en.title: “ELDEN RING”, update file “Ver.1.17” distributed. Compatibility with the DLC "Tarnished Pack" and major adjustments to game balance were made.

zh.title: 今天发布的“非常受欢迎”的合作FPS“Far Far West”的重大更新“Frostburn”。盾牌、冰魔法等诸多新元素出现

en.title: Major update “Frostburn” for the “very popular” cooperative FPS “Far Far West” released today. Many new elements such as shields and ice magic appear
en.summary: EvilRaptor and FireshineGames today (August 27, 2026) released a major update, ``Frostburn,'' for the PC cooperative FPS ``FarFarWest.'' Many new elements have been implemented, including the new element ``shield'' that prevents a certain amount of damage independent of physical strength, and the new attribute ``ice magic'' that freezes the target.

His older brother, Larry Cullen, served as a captain in the U.S. Marine Corps, which inspired him to play the role of Optimus Prime. His brother died in March 2011 at the age of 70.
